result:
Scheduled publishing is in and `bunx guren gate` passes (codegen, typecheck, lint, check, audit, tests). I ran each plan step through `plan:verify` and made one commit per step. I did not run `plan:close`, since closing is your call.

- **Storage:** `posts.published_at` is a nullable text column with a new migration. `Post.fillable` now includes `publishedAt`.
- **Validation:** `publishAt` on `POST /posts` and `PUT /posts/:id` must be an ISO 8601 date-time with `Z` or an offset. It is normalised to UTC, and absent or `null` means publish now. `next tuesday` gets a 422 with an error on `publishAt`, and nothing is saved. Updating without `publishAt` clears the schedule.
- **Visibility:** `Post.visibleTo` is used by the list and by search, so guests and other users don't see scheduled posts. The page 404s for anyone but the author. Nothing has to run when the time passes, because it is checked on every read.
- **Response shape:** posts now carry `publishedAt` in `PostResource`.
- **Pages:** the new and edit forms have a "Publish at" field. The list and show pages label posts that are still scheduled.
- **Report:** `bun run console posts:scheduled` prints `<id>\t<title>\t<published_at>` for future posts only, soonest first (ties by id). It prints nothing when nothing is scheduled.
- **Tests:** `tests/ScheduledPosts.test.ts` covers acceptance cases AC-1 to AC-13 from the plan, plus the report.

I also regenerated the `docs/spec/` views.
